questions.stem: Which development made it impossible to manage IT operations manually, giving rise to ITOps?
options: The introduction of the personal computer
The introduction of the big data era
The invention of the relational database
The move from mainframes to client-server
The adoption of agile project management
questions.explanation: With the introduction of the big data era, it became impossible to manually manage IT operations, and ITOps focuses on best-in-practice IT operations.

questions.stem: What is the stated focus of ITOps?
questions.explanation: ITOps focuses on the best in practice IT operations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is one of the main areas of focus for ITOps?
questions.explanation: The main areas of focus for ITOps are IT Service Improvement, IT Service Strategy and Design, IT Service Transition and IT Service Operations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the four main areas of focus for ITOps?
questions.explanation: IT Service Marketing is not among the four ITOps focus areas: Improvement, Strategy and Design, Transition, and Operations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is listed as a stage in the ITOps lifecycle followed by organisations?
options: Maintain the health of the IT infrastructure
questions.explanation: The ITOps lifecycle includes maintaining the health of the IT infrastructure, visibility of the IT infrastructure, automation of IT services and optimisation of IT services.

questions.stem: In the ITOps lifecycle, which stage is concerned with being able to see what is happening across the IT infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Visibility of the IT Infrastructure is one of the ITOps lifecycle stages, alongside maintaining its health, automating services and optimising services.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the ITOps lifecycle stages named in I Am Datapedia!?
options: Maintain the health of the IT infrastructure
questions.explanation: Monetisation is not part of the ITOps lifecycle; the four named stages are health, visibility, automation and optimisation.

questions.stem: ITOps includes an area of focus dealing with moving IT services from design into live use. What is this area called?
questions.explanation: IT Service Transition is one of the four main ITOps focus areas, sitting between Strategy and Design and Operations.

questions.stem: Which ITOps lifecycle stage focuses on reducing manual effort by having IT services run without human intervention?
options: Maintain the health of the IT Infrastructure
questions.explanation: Automation of IT Services is the lifecycle stage concerned with automating IT services, alongside health, visibility and optimisation.

questions.stem: ITOps has a focus area dedicated to making existing IT services better over time. What is it called?
questions.explanation: IT Service Improvement is one of the four main areas of focus for ITOps.
